keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Junior Adamu (Schalke 04).
Delay in match because of an injury Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Schalke 04 0, RB Leipzig 1. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Schalke 04 0, RB Leipzig 1.
Timo Becker (Schalke 04) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Dejan Ljubicic replaces Junior Adamu.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Christoph Baumgartner replaces Rocco Reitz.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Edin Dzeko replaces Mertcan Ayhan.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Tidiam Gomis replaces Brajan Gruda.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Ridle Baku replaces Benjamin Henrichs.
Goal! Schalke 04 0, RB Leipzig 2. Rômulo (RB Leipzig) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Antonio Nusa.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Junior Dina Ebimbe replaces Timo Becker.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Bryan Lasme replaces Hwang Hee-Chan.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Johan Bakayoko replaces Rômulo.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Nicolas Seiwald replaces Ezechiel Banzuzi.
Adil Aouchiche (Schalke 04) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Schalke 04 0, RB Leipzig 2.
